about_short_description.short_description: Mawarid Mining focuses on the sustainable mineral exploration and development of mining projects domestically and internationally.

product.name: Copper Mining Operations
product.description: Mawarid Mining has completed several copper mining projects in Oman, including Hatta, Shinas, Safwa, and Mandoos, extracting approximately 6 million tons of ore using open cut mining methods.

product.name: Al Ghuzayn Project
product.description: This is a copper mining project in Oman using subsurface underground mining techniques to minimize environmental impact, with plans to extract 6.4 million tonnes of ore over 6.5 years.

product.name: Copper Concentrate Plant
product.description: Located in Lasail, Oman, this plant processes copper ore, with a capacity of 110 t.p.h., producing over 700,000 tons of copper concentrates.

product.name: Bisesero Project
product.description: Located in Rwanda, this project involves exploration for tin, tantalite, tungsten, and gold, with historical artisanal mining of these minerals.

product.name: Sandpiper Marine Phosphate Project
product.description: This project in Namibia involves the extraction of pelletal phosphate from a deposit offshore, aiming to establish a fertilizer industry in the region.

product.name: Deep Sea Mining Finance Limited
product.description: A joint venture aiming to mine Seafloor Massive Sulphide deposits, starting with the Solwara 1 project in Papua New Guinea.
